name: legalconnect
description: Tooling shared across client/ and server/. Neither app depends on this package.

scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix client run typecheck
scripts.audit: npm --prefix server audit --audit-level=high && npm --prefix client audit --audit-level=high
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run audit
scripts.vercel-build: node scripts/assert-hosted-database-url.mjs && npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client run build
